name: contract-check-resource-budget
goal: Run checks within the admitted parent budget and use two GiB for standalone verification

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: CheckRunService.execute requests no memory amount, so the resource schema assigns 512 MiB even when its admitted caller reserved two GiB. Nested normal build/check scripts request 2048 MiB and exceed that smaller child lease. Verify needs a bounded inherited budget rather than the hidden 512 default.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing runner diagnostics cases assert statuses, retained errors and case results but never inspect the child resource budget. The canonical run/initialized case will retain those assertions and assert that its real disposable Node child receives the parent memory allocation, or the project standalone default. Preserve the method case after adoption; no standalone bug test.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 415d314483 on harbor-mbp-2, retained red 4023d71c3201ebeed68f263989155f965acb1ec4411508f87f5ec35d8e264cd6 proves the existing run case receives 512 MiB instead of its real 2048 MiB parent reservation. Original diagnostics and settlement assertions, null input checks and the admitted two-read application getter all pass first; version case passes. Two cases only. No product repair yet.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Request CPU and memory from the supplied caller environment or real parent scheduling context, with standalone defaults of one CPU and 2048 MiB. resourceWork already merges scheduling context: retain that path and both existing caller-environment reads; do not add a normalization or environment spread. Tests and authored contract remain unchanged from 415d314483.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
